subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or replace the linked fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1564 before allowing a new narrow fix for this issue?
rationale: Automation should not queue another fix while an open closing PR still claims this issue, but that fork PR is conflicting and targets the obsolete handler path rather than the current Telegram native approval runtime.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Current-Runtime Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and land a focused fix in `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt And Repair Fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to rebase and rewrite the fork PR so it drops unrelated docs edits and moves the fix to the current runtime path.

options.title: Keep Waiting On Fork PR
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the fork PR, accepting that the stale conflicting branch may continue blocking a cleaner repair lane.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Current-Runtime Fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and land a focused fix in `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the native approval lifecycle refactor that owns the current fix location and final-action shape.
